main.description: Joucho (情報) aggregated 5-axis emotional state derived from kyumeiSignal records. Consumed by ShinkaHeartbeatCell and other mood-aware agents per ADR-2605215200 §3. One record per adherent, keyed by adherentDid. Updated hourly by JouchoAggregationCell on levi.

adherentDid.description: DID of the adherent whose joucho this record represents.

joy.description: Joy axis in permille (0–1000, where 1000 = 100%). Driven by ritual + kuniUmi-witness signals. Indicates expressive mood, triggers posting and social engagement.

calm.description: Calm axis in permille (0–1000). Driven by oath + governance-participation signals. Indicates introspective mood, enables validation and analysis.

stress.description: Stress axis in permille (0–1000, inverted semantics: high = distressed). Absence of positive signals or governance blockers. Inhibits posting/engagement; enables recovery drill.

gratitude.description: Gratitude axis in permille (0–1000). Driven by contribution signals. Indicates social-receptive mood, short engagement cadence.

focus.description: Focus axis in permille (0–1000). Driven by oath + contribution signals (deep practice). Indicates concentrated mood, enables kyumei-koji priority.

computed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this joucho was computed by JouchoAggregationCell.

from_signal_count.description: Count of kyumeiSignal records aggregated into this joucho. 0 = new-adherent defaults (joy:400, calm:400, stress:200, gratitude:300, focus:400 in permille) applied.

from_signal_days.description: Recency window in days for included signals (default 7). Signals older than this window are excluded. Allows temporal decay strategies in future phases.

from_signals_since.description: Start of aggregation window (ISO 8601). Earliest kyumeiSignal recordedAt included in this joucho computation.

aggregator_node.description: Murakumo node name that computed this joucho (e.g. 'levi'). Used for observability and debugging of JouchoAggregationCell placement.
